mandala_upgraded_temple_holding_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:character }
		}
		county.holder = { save_scope_as = character }
	}
	scope:character = {
		if = {
			limit = { root.county.holder = { is_independent_ruler = no } }
			add_piety = {
				value = medium_piety_value
				multiply = 1.5
			}
			root.county.holder = {
				add_piety = {
					value = minor_piety_value
					multiply = 1.5
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_mandala }
			add_piety = {
				value = medium_piety_value
				multiply = 1.5
			}
		}
	}
}

creator_mandala_upgraded_regular_holding_piety_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { exists = scope:character }
		}
		county.holder = { save_scope_as = character }
	}
	scope:character = {
		if = {
			limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_mandala is_house_head = yes }
			add_piety = {
				value = medium_piety_value
				multiply = { value = creator_mandala_piety_gain_scale }
			}
		}
	}
}
